context: Two managers discuss a relocation project
purpose: Teach: 市役所/フロア/洗練/ハードディスク/大物/スマート/本題/紙面

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本題のフロア配置、市役所と最終確認したい。
lines.en: We need to finalize the floor layout with city hall.
lines.style: All business. Crisp opening, moving through checklist items. Not brusque—competent. The pace of someone tracking three things at once and hitting each one cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。洗練されたエントランス案、決裁待ちです。
lines.en: Right. The refined entrance proposal is waiting for approval.
lines.style: Steady, supportive. Confirming the action item without ceremony. Slight lift at the end—ready for the next one. Professional warmth, not performance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ハードディスクは廃棄方針も決めて。
lines.en: And decide on the hard-disk disposal policy too.
lines.style: Efficient. Short, direct, no wasted breath. Not unkind—just adding the next line item to the list. Quick downbeat on the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 大物のIT顧問にもスマートな助言を頂きました。
lines.en: We've already gotten smart guidance from a senior IT consultant on that.
lines.style: Reporting back. Calm competence. Light emphasis on 'already'—showing the groundwork is done. Small note of accomplishment, kept professional.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地元紙面、好意的に取り上げてくれるとありがたい。
lines.en: If the local press gives it favorable coverage, that would be helpful.
lines.style: Closing thought. Slight softening from the checklist pace—more reflective. Not a demand, more a quiet hope. Trailing slightly, as if considering what comes next.
